notes.title: Big Update! The results of the First Player Vote
notes.content:
A few days ago we added a big update to the game based on your vote.
Players have been given the opportunity to further influence neighboring countries. 
1. If you are already influencing a country, you can significantly increase the strength of your influence, but you will spend half of your income currency. 
2. You will be able to buy half of your influence on a country with Trade Points. Each country has a different price.
This changes the gameplay dramatically. Emphasize captures in the early game? Then you will get a lot of rebellions and not be able to take full advantage

We have also simplified the game for new players
3. New events have been added. When you reach the revolution and riots of a high level, events are now offered in which you can reduce the revolution and riots
4) Changed access conditions for the third Taxes tab. Now blocking a branch is clearly displayed on the whole branch with clear access conditions. We also changed the access conditions - now it depends on the scenario in which you play. It can be GDP or currency to spend or just reach a certain level.

We also added a lot of small fixes, balance fixes and additions.
After the update we were tweaking the balance for a while so we didn't make the announcement right away - but now you can enjoy them to the fullest ;)

Thank you for supporting Taxer Inc!

notes.title: Complete reworking of the game is complete!
notes.content:
The game has been completely redesigned.
- All art has been redrawn to match the new style
- All music has been removed and replaced with new music. Also all the sounds
- Many mechanics have undergone significant changes.
- We added quests to the game.
- Added "Government" mechanics.
- Added "Organization" mechanics
- Completely redesigned the balance. In fact, it was rewritten probably 3-4 times.

The last month we actively tested the game and now I think we see Taxer Inc. in the state where we would like to start the journey with you.

We think we're ready for Early Access. We are planning several votes on what part of the game should be improved and what mechanics are missing. Players will vote on what's worth working on.

Hopefully we will make it together!
